project.name: SnackShop API
project.description: REST API for a small e-commerce store: users create orders containing products, with stock guarded by transactions. JWT auth, request logging, and a nightly stock reconciliation job.

middleware.name: authenticate
middleware.description: Parse the JWT from the Authorization header. On failure return 401. Set request identity.

middleware.name: request_logger
middleware.description: Log method, path, status, latency and user id to structured JSON.

middleware.name: require_admin
middleware.description: Reject the request unless identity.role == admin. Return 403 otherwise.

functionBatches.name: insert_user
functionBatches.description: Insert a row into @user with unique-email conflict mapped to 409.

functionBatches.name: issue_token
functionBatches.description: Create signed JWT with sub=@user:C:id role=@user:C:role.

routes.execution: free: I want signup to be idempotent-safe: on duplicate email return a stable 409 with a machine-readable error code, and never leak whether an email exists elsewhere. Emails must be validated format-wise before hashing.

routes.summary: List products with optional ?limit and ?cursor pagination.

functionBatches.name: list_products
functionBatches.description: Select published products from @product, order by name, cursor paginated.

routes.execution: Return only fields the catalog exposes (id, sku, name, price). Hide stock from non-admin callers.

routes.summary: Create an order with line items, decrementing stock atomically.

functionBatches.name: validate_lines
functionBatches.description: Assert every product exists and quantity >= 1. 400 otherwise.

functionBatches.name: check_stock
functionBatches.description: SELECT stock FROM @product WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE for each line; fail whole order if any run short.

functionBatches.name: insert_order
functionBatches.description: Insert the order and its lines in one transaction.

functionBatches.name: decrement_stock
functionBatches.description: UPDATE @product SET stock = stock - ? per line.

routes.execution: run function batches in order inside a single DB transaction, rollback on any failure. Put the order id, not the child item ids, in the response body.

routes.summary: Fetch one order with its lines.

functionBatches.name: load_order
functionBatches.description: Load @order joined with its @order_item lines where id matches and user_id equals the caller, else 404.

jobs.name: expire_pending_orders
jobs.execution: Find @order rows older than 30 minutes in pending status, mark them cancelled and add their quantities back to @product.stock. Use a small batch size and log every release.

jobs.name: nightly_reconcile
jobs.execution: Compare a stock level report against the sum of open line quantities and flag discrepancies to ops.
